selection_rule.metric: validation MAE on the RAW COUNT scale (log1p model predictions inverted via expm1, clipped at 0, before computing MAE)
selection_rule.tuning_data: train on target months <= 2023-12; hyperparameters for random_forest and xgboost chosen by validation (2024 targets) MAE only; the baseline has no hyperparameters
selection_rule.step_1: tune random_forest and xgboost each on validation MAE; take each family's best configuration
selection_rule.step_2: rank the three candidates (baseline, tuned random_forest, tuned xgboost) by validation MAE, lower is better
selection_rule.step_3: if the top two are within bootstrap noise (95% grid-bootstrap CI of their validation MAE difference includes 0, 300 resamples), choose the simpler of the two by simplicity_order; otherwise choose the lower-MAE model
selection_rule.test_set_policy: 2025 is evaluated exactly once, after regression_frozen_config.json is completed with the frozen model and feature list; never re-run

selection_outcome.reason: top model clearly ahead of the runner-up

model.training: targets <= 2023-12, full training set (no class sampling; this is a regression, not a classifier)

target_transform: log1p(next_month_collisions); metrics reported after expm1() inversion, clipped at 0
xgboost_retuning_note: original XGB_GRID (depth {4,6} x lr {0.05,0.1}) picked a corner value on both dimensions; widened to depth {2,3,4,6,8} x lr {0.02,0.05,0.1} before freezing
note: This is the REGRESSION TRACK's frozen config, entirely separate from the classifier's results/frozen_config.json / results/test_evaluated.lock. The one-shot 2025 evaluation for this track writes results/regression/regression_test_evaluated.lock, never results/test_evaluated.lock.
